name: stack-initial-observation
argv: --command=set -eu; sudo systemctl is-active remission-simulation.service; sudo docker compose -p remission-simulation -f /opt/remission-simulation/compose.json ps --format json; sudo docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=remission-simulation --format "{{.ID}} {{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}"; free -b; df -B1 / /srv/remission; sudo docker stats --no-stream --format "{{.Name}} {{.MemUsage}} {{.MemPerc}} {{.CPUPerc}} {{.PIDs}}"; sudo stat -c "%d:%i %s %n" /srv/remission/data/remission.sqlite /srv/remission/data/remission.sqlite.admission.lock; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
